comments.author: @johnmorgan1376
comments.text: I used to travel to Boston when the mini computer revolution was in full swing. Does anybody remember Digital Equipment Corporation (DEC)? There were others -- Wang in Lowell, MA for example. Dr. Wang was an MIT professor. The mini computer revolution that replaced the mainframe was mostly Boston based. This revolution was superseded when  the Micro computer chip replaced transistors. The computer industry moved away from New England after that to Silicon Valley in California.
